io.milvus.v2.client

Class ConnectConfig

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.client.ConnectConfig

  • public class ConnectConfig
extends Object
    Configuration for connecting to a Milvus server.

    Use builder() to create a configuration, then pass it to the MilvusClientV2 constructor. The builder validates required fields such as uri.
